title: Chapter 4 Wooden Treasure Box
content:
Chapter 4 Wooden Treasure Box

"Thank God, Buddha bless you!"

When Wang Shuo saw the tree and the treasure chest, he seemed to see the "hope of life".

After going through so many hardships, he finally had the capital to survive. At this moment, he was so excited that he almost cried.

But this tree is located in the swamp, about 5 meters away from the edge of the swamp, just out of reach.

Hey! It's just this little bit away, don't you say it's infuriating.

Wang Shuo thought about it and thought of a way.

You can build a raft.

The "synthesis formula" of the raft just happened to be in the [synthesis formula].

Synthesize the branches and dead grass you picked up into sticks and ropes.

At this time, he had 48 sticks and 12 ropes in his backpack.

Silently recite "making a raft" in your heart.

[Raft: 48/8 sticks, 12/2 ropes]

[Are you sure you want to make a raft? 】

"Yes."

[Sticks -8, Ropes -2]

[Please wait patiently for 1 minute]

...

[Raft +1]

Putting the raft in the backpack into the swamp, Wang Shuo stood on the bamboo raft with a fine stone axe in his hand and began his tree-pulling career.

If you want to be rich, pull trees first.

When the first axe went down, the system prompt sounded:

[Red Tree: Durability 99/100]

"Dong, Dong..."

One hundred swings of the axe, each with full enthusiasm. If I had this enthusiasm when I was studying, I wouldn't have to go to vocational high school; if I had worked so hard, how could the boss have only 3 villas?

Ten minutes later, the system prompt sounded:

[Redwood found, do you want to pick it up? ]

"Yes."

[Wood +12]

[Wooden treasure chest found, do you want to pick it up? ]

"Yes."

Isn't it for this moment that I've worked so hard for most of the day?

[Wooden treasure chest +1]

Open the backpack.

Seeing a box icon in the backpack grid, Wang Shuo excitedly clicked it with trembling hands.

[“Smoothing Mud” skill book +1]

What?

That’s it?

Are you kidding me?

“What a cold winter, what a cold winter, da da da, da da da, how cold it is, I’m playing in the mud in the Northeast…” kept repeating in his mind.

…

Let me play in the mud?

And it’s still thin! ! !

The name of this skill alone - “Smoothing Mud”, made Wang Shuo a little resistant.

If it was a “Rockfall”, “Earth Spike”, “Fireball” or something like that, just hearing the name would know that it was very powerful, and from then on I would be on the fast track, and my life would not be confused.

He really wanted to turn the box upside down to see if there was anything else, but the system forgot to prompt.

Unfortunately, there was nothing inside.

“Oh, I must have not washed my hands when I opened the treasure chest!” Wang Shuo sighed.

However, I had to learn the skill I opened myself, even with tears.

Silently recited to learn “Smoothing Mud” in my heart.

At this moment, there is an additional [Skill: Smooth the Situation] in the [Character Information] panel.

[ID: 5678 Wang Shuo]

[Level: Level 1]

[Strength: 5]

[Constitution: 7]

[Agility: 5]

[Energy: 7]

[Skill: Smooth the Situation]

After clicking, each item has an explanation.

[1 point of strength, provides 1 point of physical damage; 1 point of constitution, provides 10 points of physical strength; 1 point of agility provides 1 point of speed; 1 point of energy, provides 10 points of mental strength, and 1 minute naturally restores 6 points of mental strength. ]

Equivalent to Wang Shuo's current physical damage of only 5, and the upper limit of physical strength and mental strength is only 70 points.

[Smooth the Situation: Consume 1 point of mental strength, use it on 1 cubic meter of mud pit or silt land, separate the mud and water, and get clay and water, no skill CD. ]

Wang Shuo can't wait to try this skill.

Looking around, the swamp is full of silt!

Facing the swamp in front of him, silently recite "smooth the Situation".

[Found clay and water, do you want to pick them up? ]

"Yes."

[Clay +1, Water +10]

You can play like this!

Wang Shuo couldn't help but laugh like a pig!

This skill is really good!

[Clay +2, Water +8]

[Clay +1, Water +9]

[Clay +3, Water +11]

...

Just when Wang Shuo was having fun, in the swamp mud less than 150 meters away from him, a huge toad, buried in the mud, was taking a lazy nap.

Maybe it was too cold, or it might be too full, it was too lazy to move at all. As one of the overlords in this swamp, it didn't need to worry about food at all.

In less than 20 minutes, Wang Shuo's backpack was full.

Open [Backpack].

[Wood × 12; Wooden sticks × 40; Rope × 10; Leaves × 4; Stone knife × 1; Stone axe × 1; Raft × 1; Clay × 1 set of 20; Water × 11 sets. 】

Each grid of the backpack can hold up to 100 units of the same item, and the weight of 1 unit of water is 1L.

In this way, he had 120 units of clay and 1,100L of water.

Fortunately, the system backpack had no weight.

He hurried back to the shack.

There were too many things, and he wanted to make a warehouse to store the items, but the system prompted that he had to upgrade the wooden house before he could build it.

He piled all the materials in the backpack on the ground, and when he was about to take out the water, the system prompted that he didn't have a container for water, and if he took it out directly, it would flow to the ground.

With so much clay, Wang Shuo thought that he could make some big jars, pottery jars, bowls, etc.

But now there is something more important.

Because he thought of a wonderful way to chop trees, and wanted to try it out quickly.

Near the shack, he chose a 2-meter-high tree and directly put 10 units of water. At the root of the tree, the water quickly seeped into the ground and formed a mud pit. He kept using the "mud and mud" skill.

In the blink of an eye, the soil at the root of the tree turned into clay and was put into the backpack, and a soil pit was formed in the original place. Soon the tree fell down and turned into a wooden stick and was put into the backpack.

"Nice!"

It really works.

Wang Shuo was delighted. Isn't there a way to chop trees without an axe?

Now chopping trees has become simple. This method is not only fast, but also consumes little physical strength and energy. The only problem is that trees in the swamp are hard to find and not very convenient to chop.

He looked up at the sky. The fog had dissipated a lot, and the sun was faintly visible. It was 1pm, and he still hadn't eaten a bite. His wet pants had dried a little, but they were still cold.

He sorted out his thoughts and made plans for the afternoon's work.

First, the water source had been found. Although the water was a little unclean, it was not polluted or poisonous. It only needed to be put in a pottery jar and boiled on the fire before it could be drunk.

Secondly, there was still no fire. It seemed that he could only come back and drill wood later.

Finally, there was food. His physical strength had dropped to 30/70, and he obviously felt less powerful than in the morning.

He walked in all four directions, but they were all just straight-line exploration methods.

This time he found a road he had never walked before, and he explored it in a "snake-like" way.

When he reached the edge of the swamp again, he heard the system prompt.

[The map function is turned on, and the field of vision is increased. 】

Wang Shuo opened the map and found that the 50-meter range centered on the shack was called the "territory", and the vast area outside was the "swamp", and his location was a green dot.

On the map, he could see the terrain clearly where he had walked, but the places he had not set foot on were still gray.

Isn't this just opening the map!

At the same time, the fog in front of him automatically retreated 15 meters, and he could now see 25 meters around him.

It was really great. Being able to see farther not only speeded up the search, but also greatly improved safety.

Looking up, there was a big tree in the swamp 15 meters ahead.

Fortunately, the field of vision was improved, otherwise it would be difficult to find the tree.

After releasing the raft and coming under the mangrove, he felt very comfortable at the moment, so he shouted: "Make peace with the mud."

Although he felt a little ashamed, there was no one around, so he was not afraid of being heard.

At this time, in his mind, "How cold the winter is..." turned on the automatic playback mode.

After about 5 minutes, he found that the water from all around was pouring into the pit at a faster speed, while there was not so much water near the first tree.

He used the clay he collected to surround the tree, and the water seepage was quickly alleviated.

After another 2 minutes, the tree fell down and turned into wood.

[Wood +10, Fish +1]

"Fuck! It's a fish! It's a fish! It's a fish!"

After hearing the unexpected hint, Wang Shuo burst into tears of joy. He finally found food.
